description: Implementation of UE context management for E1AP in a 3GPP-based network, including adding, removing, updating UE contexts, and ID allocation.

classes.name: e1ap_ue_context
classes.description: Represents the context of a UE in E1AP, including identifiers and logger.

classes.name: e1ap_ue_context_list
classes.description: Manages a list of UE contexts, providing methods to add, remove, update, and allocate IDs.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Adds a new UE context with specified UE index and E1AP ID, returns pointer to the context.

methods.name: remove_ue
methods.description: Removes a UE context based on UE index.

methods.name: allocate_gnb_cu_cp_ue_e1ap_id
methods.description: Allocates a new GNB CU-CP UE E1AP ID, reusing IDs if holes are available.

methods.name: update_ue_index
methods.description: Updates the UE index in the context and internal mappings.

methods.name: increase_next_cu_cp_ue_e1ap_id
methods.description: Increments the next ID to be allocated, wrapping around if maximum is reached.
